Marta: Hi team 	6 Ascend onboarding starts tomorrow. Short objective: get them to a reproducible E2E demo, agree success criteria that tie to renewal signals, and hand off enablement + feedback loop. Who from Ascend is joining? :wave:

Jules: Ascend will send PM + 2 backend devs + infra lead (Anya). I'll confirm emails in the calendar invite.

Samir: I'll own infra readiness: API keys, rate limits, staging VPC access, and perf profile. If they request a Dedicated pool we should expect +7 days. Tagging RISK-DEDICATED.

Priya: I'll run enablement. Plan: 20m product demo, 30m hands-on lab, plus a 15m ops walkthrough. Will record and publish a one-pager and a short how-to repo.

Marta: Proposed sprint (compact):
``
Day 0: kickoff + SSO & onboarding checklist review
Day 1: API integration + first-commit demo
Day 2-3: perf/quant tuning + batching config
Day 4-6: enablement labs + docs handoff
Day 7: feedback sprint + retro + go/no-go
```
Please post any blockers by EOD. :spiral_calendar_pad:

Samir: SSO/certs are the usual choke point. If cert exchange >4d telemetry and flows are unreliable. Marking RISK-SSO. Also need sample traffic (qps, token distribution) to size batching.

Jules: Success criteria suggestion (lean): "integration green (smoke tests pass) + SDKs installed in 2 environments + 1 reproducible E2E demo + 7-day retention signal >30%". That ties product usage to renewal.

Priya: I like that. For enablement feedback I'll use a short pulse survey: 3 Qs (clarity, confidence, blockers). Link posted after sessions.

Marta: Owners: Priya = enablement & feedback, Samir = infra & perf, Jules = customer liaison & logistics, Marta = exec sync & escalation.

onboard-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.checklists/3123456789 	6 includes roles, meeting links, pre-reads, and RISK tags.

Samir: Requesting Ascend staging key and jumpbox details by EOD tomorrow so we can run quantization and throughput tests.

Jules: I'll ask Anya to share jumpbox + test key. If they ask for Private deployment, I'll get an explicit statement of work and update the timeline.

Priya: I'll draft the enablement repo and a short recorded runbook. Will post links here when ready.

Marta: Daily 10-min stand during the sprint at 09:00 PST. If anyone sees a critical blocker tag it with RISK-XXX and we'll escalate. Thanks! :thumbsup:
